parent.title: Phase 2 - Controlled package installation
parent.body: Objective: deliver a usable package installation flow. Scope: package creation, isolated preflight, local installation, and diagnostics. Out of scope: automated correction and publication. Acceptance: AC01 and AC02 are satisfied.

steps.title: Prepare an incremental ZIP bundle
steps.body: Deliver a ZIP with a v1 manifest and the exact pinned base. Acceptance: its declared files and hashes are available for independent local validation.

steps.title: Validate and install the bundle locally
steps.body: Validate an isolated candidate and request local approval before installation. Acceptance: accept the authorized bundle and reject an invalid bundle without unrelated changes.
